description: Open a support ticket with EQVPS. `subject` and `message` are required; optional `service_id` ties it to one of your VPS. The response includes the ticket `code` — use that with get_ticket / reply_ticket / close_ticket. Requires: token.

message.description: Required. Problem description, up to 5000 characters: what you did, what you expected, what happened.

service_id.description: Optional. Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

subject.description: Required. Short ticket subject, up to 255 characters, e.g. "SSH refused after reboot".

name: create_ticket
title: Open a support ticket
